bullātĭo , ōnis, f. bullo,
I.a bubbling, forming of pebbles, of a stone found in small detached fragments: “sparsa bullatio magnetis (opp. cautes continua),” Plin. 34, 14, 42, § 148 Sill. and Jan. (al. bulbatio).
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
